caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent object shaped like a shoe with a handle attached to the back, resembling a mug or container. The object is primarily clear with hints of yellow and subtle gray shading to suggest its glass material and three-dimensional form. The shoe-shaped body includes a rounded toe, a slightly raised heel at the back, and visible seams and edges to emphasize its structure. Attached on the upper middle part of the shoe is a small, round, metallic-colored lid or cap. The handle is circular, attached to the heel of the shoe. The object is centrally positioned against a plain, off-white background, with minimal details or markings elsewhere on the page except for a faint inscription beneath the shoe.
title: Lamp Base
